sections.title: Planning Views
sections.description: Navigate and understand the main planning interface

topics.title: Daily View
topics.body: The **Daily View** is your day-by-day dashboard. It displays your focus items, upcoming events, tasks due today, and reminders. Use this view to start your day with a clear sense of priorities across all your domains: **Personal**, **Household**, and **Professional**. You can access the **Daily View** by selecting the day-focused planning screen from your main navigation.

topics.title: Week View
topics.body: The **Week** view shows your schedule across the current week with **time-based planning**. Events, tasks, and reminders are displayed on a timeline grid organized by day and time. You can create items by clicking on time slots, drag items to reschedule them, and toggle between **compact** and **expanded** row heights. The week view supports **work week only** mode (Mon-Fri) for focused scheduling.

topics.title: Calendar View
topics.body: The **Calendar** view displays your month at a glance. Click on any day to see details for that date. You can navigate between months using the controls, jump to specific months, and see **all-day events** highlighted at the top of each day. The calendar integrates with your **events**, **tasks**, and **reminders** across all domains.

sections.title: Planning Items
sections.description: Create and manage events, tasks, and reminders

topics.title: Creating Planning Items
topics.body:
You can create three types of **planning items**: **Events** (calendar-based occurrences), **Tasks** (actionable work items), and **Reminders** (time-based nudges). Create items by:

• Clicking **+ New Item** buttons in any view
• Clicking directly on time slots in the **Week** view
• Right-clicking on calendar dates in the **Calendar** view
• Using quick add from the **Today** view

Each item requires a **title** and **domain** (Personal, Household, or Professional). Assign it to a **bucket** within that domain.

topics.title: Item Properties
topics.body:
When creating or editing a **planning item**, you can set:

• **Title**: Name of the item
• **Notes**: Additional details or context
• **Sub-items**: Checkboxes for breaking work into steps
• **Priority**: Low, Medium, High
• **Start/End dates** and **times** (for events)
• **All-day** flag
• **Location** field for events
• **Due date** and **time** (for tasks)
• **Repeat rule**: None, Daily, Weekdays, Weekly, Monthly, Alternate Workdays
• **Reminder lead time**: At time, 5 min, 15 min, 30 min, 1 hour, 1 day
• **Estimated duration** (in minutes, for tasks)

topics.title: Repeat Rules
topics.body:
**Repeat rules** let you schedule recurring items:

• **None**: One-time item (default)
• **Daily**: Every day
• **Weekdays**: Monday through Friday only
• **Weekly**: Same day each week
• **Monthly**: Same date each month
• **Alternate Workdays**: Every other business day (for rotating schedules)

Select a repeat rule when creating or editing an item. Recurring items appear on all applicable dates in your calendar and views.

topics.title: Sub-Items and Checklists
topics.body:
Break down larger **tasks** and **events** into smaller **sub-items**. Sub-items are checkboxes that let you track progress on multi-step work. Click the **+** button in the sub-items section to add new ones. Check off sub-items as you complete them. Sub-items support several types:

• **Task** checkboxes
• **Reminders** for specific steps
• **URLs** for reference links
• **Journal entries** for attached notes
• **Map trips** for location-based steps
• **Outfits** for planning what to wear
• **Weather reports** for conditions you need to prepare for
• **PDF files** for attached documents

topics.title: Editing and Deleting Items
topics.body:
To **edit** a planning item, click the **pencil icon** in item cards or popover, or double-click the item. This opens the editor sheet where you can modify all properties. Changes are saved immediately.

To **delete** an item, open the item editor and click **Delete** (with red text). Deleting an item removes it and all its sub-items. This cannot be undone.

sections.title: Domains & Buckets
sections.description: Organize your life into three domains with custom buckets

topics.title: What Are Domains?
topics.body:
**Domains** are three high-level life categories in TimeScape:

• **Personal**: Individual goals, health, habits, interests, and self-care
• **Household**: Home operations, family coordination, chores, and shared responsibilities
• **Professional**: Career, work projects, job responsibilities, and professional goals

Every **planning item** (event, task, reminder) must belong to exactly one **domain**. This helps you balance your life and see how much time/energy goes to each area.

topics.title: What Are Buckets?
topics.body:
**Buckets** are containers within each **domain** that group related items. For example:

**Personal domain** buckets: Fitness, Reading, Hobbies, Health
**Household domain** buckets: Meals, Cleaning, Maintenance, Family
**Professional domain** buckets: Project A, Project B, Administrative Tasks

Every **planning item** is assigned to a **bucket** within its **domain**. Buckets use custom colors and icons for visual organization. Each domain has a default **General** bucket for miscellaneous items.

topics.title: Creating Buckets
topics.body:
To create a new **bucket** in a **domain**:

1. Navigate to the domain section (**Personal**, **Household**, or **Professional**)
2. Click **+ New Bucket**
3. Enter the **bucket name**, choose a **color** and **icon**
4. Add an optional **description** for context
5. Click **Create**

For **Professional** domain, you can mark a bucket as a **Job** and enter:
• **Pay rate** and **pay period** (hourly, weekly, etc.)
• **Job site** location
• **Holiday patterns** for time off

For **Personal** domain, you can mark a bucket as a **Routine** with a frequency setting.

topics.title: Managing Buckets
topics.body:
To **edit** a bucket, click the **three dots** menu on the bucket card and select **Edit Bucket**. You can change the name, color, icon, description, and job/routine settings.

To **archive** a bucket, click the **three dots** menu and select **Archive**. Archived buckets hide their items from normal views. Click **View Archived** to see and unarchive them.

To **delete** a bucket, click the **three dots** menu and select **Delete** (only available for non-default buckets). Deleting a bucket does not delete its items; they move to the domain's **General** bucket.

topics.title: Default Buckets
topics.body: Each **domain** has a **General** default bucket that cannot be deleted. When you first create an item in a domain without specifying a bucket, it's assigned to the **General** bucket. You can still edit the item later to move it to a different bucket or keep it in **General**.

sections.title: Companion Applications
sections.description: Use specialized tools to enhance your planning

topics.title: Companion Apps Hub
topics.body:
The **Apps** hub shows all available **companion applications** that work with TimeScape. Each app opens in its own dedicated **window**. Current and planned apps include:

• **Journal** (Live) - Capture timestamped entries with mood tags
• **Meals** (Live) - Plan meals, generate grocery lists, track nutrition
• **Dynamic Weather** (Preview) - View forecast-aware planning insights
• **Dynamic Map** (Preview) - Map locations, build routes, sync destinations
• **Budgeting** (Preview) - Track income, expenses, and bucket-linked spending

Click an app tile to see details, then click **Open [App]** to launch it in a new window.

topics.title: Journal App
topics.body:
The **Journal** app lets you create **timestamped entries** with **mood tags**. Create entries to capture thoughts, reflections, or notes. Each entry stores:

• **Title** - What the entry is about
• **Body** - Your full entry text
• **Mood** - How you felt when writing (Neutral, Energized, Calm, Focused, Stressed)
• **Timestamp** - When the entry was created

You can attach **journal entries** as sub-items to **planning items**, creating a link between your planning and journaling.

topics.title: Meals App
topics.body:
The **Meals** app helps you plan weekly meals and manage nutrition. Features include:

• **Plan meals** - Assign breakfast, lunch, and dinner for each day of the week
• **Grocery list generation** - Automatically create a checklist from planned meal ingredients
• **Nutrition tracking** - View daily and weekly nutrition facts for your meals
• **Meal templates** - Save favorite meals for quick reuse
• **Grocery task bridge** - Convert grocery lists into **task sub-items** in your **Household** domain

Click on a meal to edit it or select an empty cell to create a new meal.

topics.title: Dynamic Map App
topics.body:
The **Dynamic Map** app (in preview) helps you visualize and optimize your routes. It:

• **Syncs locations** from planning items and professional bucket job sites
• **Builds multi-stop routes** with estimated drive times and alternatives
• **Shows traffic-aware ETAs** for each stop
• **Writes destinations back** to your planning items

Manage location sources, select stops to include, and optimize your route before heading out. Great for professional domain planning and household errands.

topics.title: Companion Window Management
topics.body:
Each **companion app** opens in its own **singleton window** - only one instance can be open at a time. Windows are independent of the main app, so you can:

• Move them to a different monitor
• Resize them to your needs
• Minimize them without affecting the main app
• Close them and reopen later without losing state

Click **Help → Show Help** to access this help window anytime. Use the menu bar or keyboard shortcuts to open companion apps.

topics.title: Settings Overview
topics.body:
The **Settings** view lets you customize how TimeScape works. Access **Settings** from the sidebar or use the navigation menu. Key settings areas include:

• **Display preferences** - Theme, colors, view modes
• **Notification settings** - How and when you receive **reminders**
• **Data management** - Export/import, backup locations
• **Domain defaults** - Which domain is active when you launch
• **Integration options** - Connect to external calendars or services
• **Profile** - Your name, time zone, language

Settings are saved automatically; changes take effect immediately.

topics.title: Profile Settings
topics.body:
In **Profile settings**, you can:

• **Set your name** - Used in "Your Planner" title and greetings
• **Select your time zone** - Ensures all scheduling is accurate to your location
• **Choose language** - Currently English; more coming soon
• **Set default domain** - Which domain (Personal, Household, Professional) opens when you launch the app

These settings are stored locally on your Mac.

topics.title: Notification Preferences
topics.body:
Control how **reminders** notify you:

• **Enable notifications** - Toggle system notifications on/off
• **Sound** - Play a sound when reminders trigger
• **Banner** - Show a banner notification
• **Alert** - Show an alert dialog
• **Lead time defaults** - Set the default **reminder lead time** for new items (At time, 5 min, 15 min, 30 min, 1 hour, 1 day)

Individual items can override these defaults.

topics.title: Data Export & Backup
topics.body:
**Export your data** to keep backups or move to another device:

• **Export all** - Export all buckets, items, and journal entries as JSON
• **Export domain** - Export only one domain (Personal, Household, Professional)
• **Backup location** - Choose where backups are saved
• **Auto-backup** - Enable automatic daily backups

All data is stored in standard formats (JSON, ICS for calendars) for maximum portability.

topics.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
topics.body:
TimeScape supports standard **macOS keyboard shortcuts**:

• **⌘?** - Open Help window
• **⌘N** - Create new planning item (in most views)
• **⌘S** - Save current view (for exports)
• **⌘,** (Comma) - Open Settings
• **⌘W** - Close current window
• **⌘Q** - Quit TimeScape
• **⌘←** - Go to previous date/period
• **⌘→** - Go to next date/period

Many of these follow standard Mac conventions.

topics.title: Accessibility Features
topics.body:
TimeScape is designed to be accessible:

• **Dark mode support** - Full support for macOS Dark Mode and Light Mode
• **Keyboard navigation** - Navigate between sections and items using Tab and arrow keys
• **VoiceOver** - Compatible with macOS VoiceOver screen reader
• **High contrast** - All UI elements meet WCAG accessibility standards
• **Font sizing** - Respects macOS font size settings in some areas

If you have specific accessibility needs, check **Settings → Accessibility** for additional options.
